question: Does the already-tested rule-only static_v2 candidate retain any finite utility advantage over Unit on fresh generated 5x5 rules when candidate and fixed foe receive the same D3/8192-node/0.5-second budget?
changed_premise: The corrected candidate96 panel used candidate D8/8192/0.5s against foe D2/32768/0.5s. Earlier work curves used D3 and D8 against D2 on other generated rules but did not include a dedicated fresh 5x5 D3-versus-D3 panel. This changes the resource regime and uses disjoint rules and prefixes; it is not a refill or repooling of existing panels.

rules.selection: All eight deterministic generated rules and all prespecified prefixes are retained without outcome/feature filtering. Seeds differ from the 521001..521008 and 522001..522008 5x5 panels.

roots.terminal_prefixes: Retain as zero-search terminal slots; do not replace.

arms.color_swap: Both candidate colors on each identical rule/root/foe pair. Candidate and foe checkpoints are fixed before play.

outcomes.horizon: Stop after 96 legal candidate plies unless a true Core terminal occurs first. Ongoing at the horizon is UNKNOWN; retain it as [-1,1], never impute draw or extend.
outcomes.actual_terminal: Score the actual Core Session result, including repetition and rule max-ply terminals.
outcomes.contrast: Within each rule/root/foe/color-swapped pair, static_v2 candidate reward minus Unit candidate reward; report each foe, candidate owner, seed, all-slot bounds and actual cost separately.
outcomes.decision: Strictly positive all-slot bounds against both fixed foes retain static_v2 as a viable candidate for this sampled 5x5 symmetric-D3 regime; nonpositive upper bounds against both de-prioritize it only for this regime. Otherwise unresolved. No global/default/strength claim.

cost.expected: Below 4 minutes: the prior corrected 128-game 5x5 panel closed in 74.688 seconds with a deeper candidate D8/8192 budget and shallower D2/32768 foe; this D3/8192 symmetric arm should use no more search nodes per call and the same slots/horizon. Hard cap is 2400 seconds, so expected run is below 120 minutes.
cost.cheaper_alternative: The existing D8-vs-D2 panel and multi-size D3-vs-D8 curves do not test a dedicated symmetric D3-vs-D3 5x5 regime. The cheaper alternative is to defer, but it leaves the specified deployment-regime comparison unanswered.

integrity: No training, solver, auxiliary checkout or prior panel refill.
Preserve complete rules, promotion, drops, auxiliary state, GameSession history and true terminal results.
Keep each seed/root/failure/UNKNOWN; no seed replacement, outcome imputation, cross-panel pooling or population claim.
